# Structured "adversarial" k set for hybrid-W_hat F_k Monte-Carlo experiments.
# Intended to stress small-prime/gcd structure, not to be exhaustive.
#
# k must be in [1, N-4] for N≈1,010,000.
#
# Contents:
#   - multiples of primorial(11)=2310
#   - multiples of lcm(1..10)=2520
#   - multiples of primorial(13)=30030
#   - multiples of lcm(1..12)=27720
#   - multiples of lcm(1..14)=360360
#   - multiples of lcm(1..16)=720720
#   - clusters around 30,000*m with offsets in [-1000,1000] step 200 for m=1..33
